MentoringCell.title: Mentoring Cell
MentoringCell.description: The basic idea of Mentoring cell is to create a conducive environment for faculty (Mentor) and student (Mentee) relationship. In order to resolve day to day academic problems of the students the following guidelines are followed in our college NDC. The main objective is to motivate the students and develop confidence to take up challenging tasks in their live and help the society in the nation building.

GuideLines.title: Guidelines For Mentors
points: Each mentor is allotted with a batch of 30- 40 students, as suggested by the principal in consultation with respective Head of the Departments.
Mentors should conduct at least three meetings
Mentors should take care of mentee’s batch for academic interests and support them for improvement.
Mentors should encourage students for extracurricular activities within the institute and at university as well as inter-University level.
Mentors should interact with parents only in case of extreme situations.
Mentors should maintain records of all the meetings held with mentees/ parents.
Mentors should update regularly the record in the formats / mentoring form supplied.
The record has to be handed over to the new mentor in case mentors are changed.

RedRessalCellSection.title: Redressal Cell
RedRessalCellSection.description: The Cell enables students to express feelings by initiating and chasing the grievance procedure in accordance with the rules and regulations of the College. ‘Student’s Grievance Cell’ enquires and analyses the nature and pattern of the grievances in a strictly confidential manner. Cell ensures Prominence on fairness with a view to “the right to be heard and right to be treated without bias”. The cell members report directly to principal.

sections.title: Our Vision
sections.description: To develop a responsive and accountability among all the stakeholders in order to maintain a harmonious educational atmosphere in the institute.

sections.title: Our Mission
list: To support those students who have been deprived of the services offered by the college, for which he / she is entitled.
To make officials of the college responsive, accountable and courteous in dealing with the students.
To ensure effective solution to the students' grievances with an impartial and fair approach.

sections.title: Functions
list: Redressal of Students’ Grievances to solve their academic and administrative problems.
To co-ordinate between students and Departments / Sections to redress the grievances.
To guide ways and means to the students to redress their problems.

ProcedureSection.title: Procedure For Loading Complaint
procedurepoints: The students can lodge their grievance through online mechanism in the link provided below - https://forms.gle/up7K5DsYu2AbjBFm7 for lodging grievance
The students may feel free to drop the writing (can be anonymous if required) in the grievance / suggestion box.
The Grievance Cell will act upon those cases which have been forwarded along with the necessary documents.

sections.title: “The best way to predict the future is to create it."- Abraham Lincoln
sections.description: NDC is proud of being a focal point for the Commerce, Management and Computer Application Education in Bangalore. The institute focuses on excellence. NDC Career Advancement Centre looks at the future horizons of career opportunities for the students.

sections.title: The Centre aims at:
list: Grooming the students perfectly for their career ahead.
Campus to Corporate training initiated from the first year.
Collaborations with different industries, institutions, and associations for training programs and internships for the students.
Industrial visits are conducted regularly for more exposure and to learn from the experts.

TrainingPlacementAndInternshipCell.title: Training and Placement Cell
TrainingPlacementAndInternshipCell.description: The Training and placement cell of Nagarjuna Degree College was started to impart to Bridge Gap Between Industry And Academic Through Mutually Exploring The Opportunities Organizing Aptitude & Corporate Skills Training Program To Prepare Out Students To Face Campus Recruitment Process To Update Students For The Competitive Examinations From Experts Arranging Technical Seminars And Arranging Guest Lecture By Eminent Personalities From Industry & Career Counselling Arranging Interview Activities for Students

sections.title: Our Vision
sections.description: To enhance employability of the students by empowering them with corporate communication skills, technical competence, leadership, techno-managerial qualities, to provide personal and career related support to ensure they are industry ready.

sections.title: Our Mission
sections.description: Mentor and prepare every student for their careers. Transform them into well-rounded professionals & empathetic humans, who are ready to take on the industry with their skills and knowledge.
